title: Paloma and the Signal
author: Odile Lockridge
blurb: Jude Sandoval, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the jump window closes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
